description: Make a Standard MIDI File from notes written as text: tokens such as C4:4 (middle C, a quarter note), E4:8 (an eighth), R:4 (a rest) and C4+E4+G4:2 (a chord, a half note), separated by spaces or commas, with | starting a new track that plays at the same time. A note is a letter A to G with # or b and an octave -1 to 9, or a MIDI number 0 to 127. The answer carries the file as midi_base64 with its tracks, notes, tempo and length. Nothing is stored. No API key, no account and no sign up.

program.description: The General MIDI program, 0 (the grand piano) by default.

name: create_midi
title: Make a MIDI file from notes
